## Ordered by Priority

### Blocker

**T01 — Fix PRIVACY.md cache claim** (`F-C-001`)
Chrome Web Store compliance defect. `PRIVACY.md` states `cache: force-cache`; actual runtime uses `cache: 'default'`. One-line fix. Human approval required before Web Store re-submission. Zero ZERO-DIFF impact during the scaffold program (PRIVACY.md is protected; this change executes post-program).

### High

**T02 — Exclude .md files from extension zip** (`F-F-002`)
Agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md, HANDOFF.md, CONTEXT.md) are currently packaged into the extension zip and shipped to the Web Store. Fix the zip script to use an explicit allowlist of user-facing docs only. Human approval required; changes the release artifact.

**T04 — Add VSC_SAVE_SETTINGS payload validation** (`F-G-001`)
Security: page scripts on any injected site can currently write arbitrary keys to `chrome.storage.sync`. Add a key allowlist in `src/content/injector.js`. Human approval required; src/ change; requires characterization test first.

**T05 — Add StorageManager.onChanged relay** (`F-B-001`)
New capability: settings changes currently do not propagate to open tabs without a reload. This ticket enables live propagation. Human approval required for scope decision + src/ change. Must coordinate with T04 (avoid amplifying unvalidated writes).

**T07 — Split HANDOFF.md into durable ADR/context and ephemeral notes** (`F-D-001`, `F-C-003`)
HANDOFF.md (~8,800 tokens) is never auto-loaded and mixes permanent architecture knowledge with stale session notes. Split into `docs/ai_generated/architecture-invariants.md` (durable) + slimmed ephemeral HANDOFF.md. Add pointer to CLAUDE.md. Human approval required for split-point judgment.

### Medium

**T03 — Remove dead src/module-loader.js** (`F-B-002`)
Dead code in web_accessible_resources expands attack surface and confuses agents. Requires characterization test (T08 must be landed first) and manifest.json change. Human approval required; touches both ZERO-DIFF surfaces (src/ and manifest.json).

**T06 — Fix mutating build gate** (`F-E-002`)
`npm run build` mutates files before testing; no CI-safe check equivalent exists. Add `check:lint` and `check:format` scripts to package.json. No human approval required; additive scripts-only change explicitly permitted by Charter §5.

**T08 — Register scaffold tests in run-tests.js** (S-12)
New test files under `tests/unit/scaffold/` are silently ignored by the explicit-list runner. Register the scaffold/ path. Unblocks characterization test prerequisites for T03, T04, T05. Human approval required; modifies existing tests/run-tests.js.
